1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

1377|900ed517.name: Pilot Stonegear
1377|900ed517.text: Driving a Steam Tank isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

273|1299e7cb.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
273|1299e7cb.text: Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

288|07ae01e9.name: Jitters
288|07ae01e9.text: Huh?!?  Oh.  You don't look like a Defias thief...or a member of the Night Watch.  Take pity on a poor soul, will ya?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3136|2e231d45.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|2e231d45.text: Yeah, I've heard through the grapevine that I might be seeing you sooner or later. But I don't just take on anyone, I need to make sure you have what it takes first. You willing to take my little test and find out?

313|be6b48f2.name: Theocritus
313|be6b48f2.text:
Welcome to the Tower of Azora, young $C.  I am Theocritus.

Do you have business with me?  Or...do I have business with you, perhaps?

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

4974|e9a7b43b.name: Aldwin Laughlin
4974|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5193|e9a7b43b.name: Rebecca Laughlin
5193|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5491|08830bac.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

6031|86adad20.name: Tormus Deepforge
6031|86adad20.text: Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

911|7a171557.name: Llane Beshere
911|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

913|7a171557.name: Lyria Du Lac
913|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

115-accept.name: Marshal Marris
115-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
115-accept.title: Shadow Magic

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-complete.text:
By the Light!  The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall.  And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire?  There is some treachery abound.  How could this be so? 

Oh I forgot to reward your service, $c.  Here are some coins.  Now excuse me.  Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
146-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

15-accept.name: Marshal McBride
15-accept.text:
$N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15-accept.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

15-complete.name: Marshal McBride
15-complete.text: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
15-complete.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

150-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

It's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
150-complete.title: Murloc Poachers

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

156-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-accept.text:
If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.

Rot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!

The Raven Hill Cemetery and the Tranquil Gardens are both lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
156-accept.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

158-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
158-complete.text: You need some Zombie Juice, do you?  Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
158-complete.title: Zombie Juice

1653-complete.name: Jordan Stilwell
1653-complete.text:
Good day, $N. The Light is with you, I trust?

What's that? You were sent by Duthorian!? My wife, how is she? I knew there was going to be trouble if I left. Please tell me she's... oh, thank goodness. I'm so glad that she's safe. The Defias were a threat long before these attacks, but now the King's advisors cannot deny it.

What else did Duthorian have to say?

You're the one that was sent to protect my wife? Then I thank you again, $N. I couldn't think of a better test of valor than that.
1653-complete.title: The Test of Righteousness

1654-accept.name: Jordan Stilwell
1654-accept.text:
I'd like to reward you if you'd be willing to accept such a thing? Don't misunderstand me, my generosity is dependent on how much help you can be, but I see us both benefiting greatly from such an alliance.

I will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. What do you say, $c?
1654-accept.title: The Test of Righteousness

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

173-accept.name: Calor
173-accept.text:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
173-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

173-complete.name: Calor
173-complete.text:
Impressive, $N. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.

It is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
173-complete.title: Worgen in the Woods

177-complete.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-complete.text: Most superb!  This will work perfectly.  Many thanks!
177-complete.title: Look to the Stars

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

178-accept.name: Unknown
178-accept.text:
<You hear a disembodied voice...>

Do not be alarmed.  I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest.  The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.

Through months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants.  If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.

Bring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.
178-accept.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

178-complete.name: Theocritus
178-complete.text:
You have my gratitude, $N.  I sent that message to the Shadowhide Pendants weeks ago and had believed it a failure.  But it seems the spell did reach at least some pendants, after a significant delay.

In time I hope to learn how to send an attack through the pendants, to immobilize any Shadowhide Gnolls who wear them.

But before that is possible, I'm afraid that much more research is required.
178-complete.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

178-progress.name: Theocritus
178-progress.text: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say?  Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.
178-progress.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

18-accept.name: Deputy Willem
18-accept.text:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18-accept.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-complete.name: Deputy Willem
18-complete.text: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18-complete.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

181-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-accept.text:
Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.

There is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
181-accept.title: Look to the Stars

19-accept.name: Marshal Marris
19-accept.text: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
19-accept.title: Tharil'zun

19-complete.name: Marshal Marris
19-complete.text: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.
19-complete.title: Tharil'zun

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2038-accept.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-accept.text:
As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, $N. For Gnomeregan!
2038-accept.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2038-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-complete.text: You've done the movement a great service, $N. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
2038-complete.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2039-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2039-complete.text:
So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
2039-complete.title: Find Bingles

21-accept.name: Marshal McBride
21-accept.text:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, $N.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21-accept.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

21-complete.name: Marshal McBride
21-complete.text: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21-complete.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

2158-accept.name: Falkhaan Isenstrider
2158-accept.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158-accept.title: Rest and Relaxation

2158-complete.name: Innkeeper Farley
2158-complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158-complete.title: Rest and Relaxation

221-accept.name: Calor
221-accept.text:
You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.

On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

Be on your guard.
221-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

240-accept.name: Chef Grual
240-accept.text: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
240-accept.title: Return to Jitters

240-complete.name: Jitters
240-complete.text:
Aha!  Thank you, $N.  Those really hit the spot!

And here, please let me pay you for these!
240-complete.title: Return to Jitters

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

255-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-complete.text: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
255-complete.title: Mercenaries

256-complete.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-complete.text:
Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...

Bloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
256-complete.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

262-complete.name: Madame Eva
262-complete.text:
Hmm... Someone handled this book recently, someone who is driven by revenge.  But the impressions left on it, at least the impressions from the original owner, are faint.

I can tell, however, that the original owner of this book is not a native of Darkshire.
262-complete.title: The Shadowy Figure

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-accept.name: Madame Eva
265-accept.text:
Here is your book back, $N, and I bid you fortune with your search.  If you ask others in town, perhaps they can offer you more clues.

And here is one more for you - although the author of this book is a stranger to Darkshire, the book itself was purchased here.
265-accept.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

265-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
265-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  I sold this book a month ago to a shady person.  He didn't tell me his name, but he was a nervous, jittery chap, always looking over his shoulder.

I hope that helps you...
265-complete.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
266-accept.text:
Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.

You might want to expand your search to the inn.  If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.
266-accept.title: Inquire at the Inn

266-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-complete.text:
Oh yeah, I remember this book.  Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.

He left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something.  Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.

The first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...
266-complete.title: Inquire at the Inn

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-accept.name: Jitters
268-accept.text:
The book you found was only half finished.  I had to leave it at Sven's farm when I fled there...

Here.  Take my completed journal to Sven.  It describes more fully what happened at his farm.

Although this journal has been my only company these past weeks, if giving it up keeps me from having to face Sven and his wrath, then I do it willingly!
268-accept.title: Return to Sven

268-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
268-complete.text: This journal explains much to me, and sets me on the path against the dark riders!  I have seen these riders in Duskwood, and have seen them speak with the wizard Morbent Fel, at the Forlorn Rowe.
268-complete.title: Return to Sven

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

2922-accept.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2922-accept.text:
When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot.  It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized.  Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed.  It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

But perhaps it can be salvaged.  Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
2922-accept.title: Save Techbot's Brain!

2923-complete.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2923-complete.text: Yes it's true.  Techbot has gone rogue!  Please, can you help me?
2923-complete.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

2927-accept.name: Gnoarn
2927-accept.text:
You don't think I was always bald, do you? No sir! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth.

<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>

Damn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!

Perhaps it's not too late, $N. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
2927-accept.title: The Day After

297-accept.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-accept.text:
Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols.  But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins!  And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs.  It makes them go berserk!

Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
297-accept.title: Gathering Idols

297-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-complete.text:
You got them!  Nicely done, $N!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
297-complete.title: Gathering Idols

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
298-accept.text:
I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder!  Here's the report.  Take it to Jern Hornhelm.  He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
298-accept.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-complete.text:
Bah!  Ironband's having trouble with the Troggs.  I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...

Well, either way it's powder well spent!

But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago.  I wonder where it went...
298-complete.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
301-accept.text:
We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.

You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
301-accept.title: Report to Ironforge

301-complete.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-complete.text:
Curse that Ironband!  I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.

So...where did the blastpowder go?!?
301-complete.title: Report to Ironforge

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

302-accept.name: Prospector Stormpike
302-accept.text:
If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it!  I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.  He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.

And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination.  The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
302-accept.title: Powder to Ironband

3100-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3100-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local $c trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3100-accept.title: Simple Letter

3100-complete.name: Llane Beshere
3100-complete.text:
Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

The Knights of the Silver Hand have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a $c can give them. Good luck.
3100-complete.title: Simple Letter

3100-progress.name: Llane Beshere
3100-progress.text:
Ah, you got my letter, $N... good.

There's been an influx of warriors in Elwynn recently--which is good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and Defias in the area.
3100-progress.title: Simple Letter

323-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
323-accept.text:
Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders.  I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.

You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
323-accept.title: Proving Your Worth

33-accept.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-accept.text:
I hate those nasty timber wolves!  But I sure like eating wolf steaks...  Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.

Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.
33-accept.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

337-accept.name: Unknown
337-accept.text:
Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine.  Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.

It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
337-accept.title: An Old History Book

344-complete.name: Brother Paxton
344-complete.text: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is?  Well this is a tad embarrassing.  I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!
344-complete.title: Brother Paxton

345-accept.name: Brother Paxton
345-accept.text:
I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...

Well you see, I make my own ink for books I copy.  It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly  Unfortunately, it dries too quickly!  My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!

To make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the Redridge Mountains.  Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.
345-accept.title: Ink Supplies

345-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
345-complete.text: You need what??  Maybe you haven't noticed, but we're busy fortifying Lakeshire's defenses and repairing damage from recent orc attacks.  If you need Rethban Iron Ore, you'll have to get it yourself!
345-complete.title: Ink Supplies

346-accept.name: Brother Paxton
346-accept.text: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron.  Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
346-accept.title: Return to Kristoff

346-complete.name: Brother Kristoff
346-complete.text: That's the one!  Thank you, $N.  May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
346-complete.title: Return to Kristoff

346-progress.name: Brother Kristoff
346-progress.text: Were you able to find the book?
346-progress.title: Return to Kristoff

347-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
347-accept.text:
Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban.  When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes.  It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.

We usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any.  And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.

So if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
347-accept.title: Rethban Ore

347-complete.name: Brother Paxton
347-complete.text:
Oh, splendid!  I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.

Thank you, $N!
347-complete.title: Rethban Ore

347-progress.name: Brother Paxton
347-progress.text: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
347-progress.title: Rethban Ore

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

386-accept.name: Guard Berton
386-accept.text:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, $N.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
386-accept.title: What Comes Around...

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3905-accept.text:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905-accept.title: Grape Manifest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

418-complete.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-complete.text:
Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
418-complete.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

436-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
436-complete.text:
Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
436-complete.title: Ironband's Excavation

453-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
453-accept.text:
Good luck, $N.  I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.

If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
453-accept.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

453-complete.name: Jitters
453-complete.text:
<Jitters sighs...>

Yes, I'm the author of that book.  You finally found me, eh?

Well if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
453-complete.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

455-accept.name: Mountaineer Rockgar
455-accept.text:
Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have a haven in the Wetlands.  And now they have expanded into Dun Algaz!  We can't let them keep their foothold here or Loch Modan will be cut off from Menethil Harbor, our port and stronghold in the Wetlands.

Break through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands beyond, and kill some orcs for good measure!  Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Menethil is through Dun Algaz, then north along the road, then west at the fork.

We're counting on you, $N.  Do not fail.
455-accept.title: The Algaz Gauntlet

466-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
466-accept.text:
I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate.  Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!

Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.

Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining.  If you don't have it, then ... bring a friend who does to that cave!
466-accept.title: Search for Incendicite

467-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
467-accept.text:
Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should!  And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him.  If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
467-accept.title: Stonegear's Search

467-complete.name: Pilot Stonegear
467-complete.text: Hello $N.  You're here about the task I have, eh?  It's good to see a young $r like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
467-complete.title: Stonegear's Search

468-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
468-accept.text:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
468-accept.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

468-complete.name: Mountaineer Rockgar
468-complete.text:
Hello, $C!  You're here for the scouting mission, are you?  Very good!

I hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...
468-complete.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

5261-accept.name: Deputy Willem
5261-accept.text:
Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him.  That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.

If you're interested then speak with Eagan.  He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.
5261-accept.title: Eagan Peltskinner

5261-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
5261-complete.text: That's true.  I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves!  Are you that person?
5261-complete.title: Eagan Peltskinner

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

56-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-complete.text: Splendid, $N.  For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.
56-complete.title: The Night Watch

57-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
57-accept.text: $N, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest!  If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.  There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.  The undead must be driven from Duskwood!
57-accept.title: The Night Watch

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-complete.name: Deputy Willem
6-complete.text: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6-complete.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

7-accept.name: Marshal McBride
7-accept.text: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
7-accept.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

7-complete.name: Marshal McBride
7-complete.text:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7-complete.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

783-accept.name: Deputy Willem
783-accept.text:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young $c, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
783-accept.title: A Threat Within

783-complete.name: Marshal McBride
783-complete.text:
Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.

I hope it's enough.

The $r lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

It is a many-fronted battle we wage, $N.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.
783-complete.title: A Threat Within

91-complete.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-complete.text: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N.  By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
91-complete.title: Solomon's Law

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

92-complete.name: Chef Breanna
92-complete.text: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
92-complete.title: Redridge Goulash

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

93-complete.name: Chef Grual
93-complete.text:
Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there!  Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...

And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
93-complete.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

94-accept.name: Theocritus
94-accept.text:
My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.  I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.

But to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.

If you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar.  Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.

When this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
94-accept.title: A Watchful Eye

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade
